title: The Long March
setup: Your h-pawn has marched all the way to the seventh rank, and Black's king on g6 is one step from eating it.
hint: Waiting loses the pawn. Finish the journey now, and choose the strongest piece it can become.
explanation:
## The Idea

The black king on g6 touches h7, so any quiet move lets it take the pawn, and a lone king against a lone king is a draw. {{h8=Q}} ends that: the pawn leaves h7 on the move it was attacked, and h8 is out of the king's reach.

A rook would also win, only slowly. The queen is nine points, and king and queen against a lone king always wins.
